department: Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering

deadline.value: Apply by December 15, 2026 (preferred deadline for funding); the final deadline for international applicants is February 26, 2027. Decisions are rolling.
deadline.quote: December 15 is the preferred deadline for best consideration for financial aid. | February 26 is the final deadline for all international students to apply.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

gre_general.value: GRE scores are optional for Fall 2027.

supervisor.value: Research assistantships come from individual faculty, so contacting faculty you want to work with is suggested.
supervisor.quote: You may wish to contact faculty members with whom you are interested in working to inquire about GRA opportunities.

funding.value: Aid (fellowships, TA and RA posts) goes to exceptionally qualified applicants who apply by December 15.
funding.quote: The department offers various types of financial aid to exceptionally qualified applicants.

entry_route.value: Apply with a bachelor's in ECE or a related field and a GPA of 3.5 (B+) or better.
entry_route.quote: applicants should hold an undergraduate degree in electrical or computer engineering or a related field (math, computer science, physics, or other areas of engineering)

fee_waiver.value: A limited number of fee waivers for PhD applicants, first come first served.
fee_waiver.quote: We are currently offering a limited number of application fee waivers to Ph.D. applicants. | Fee waivers are available on a first-come, first-served basis.
